title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. translated_title: 大语言模型能否进行长时程推理？面向纵向临床推理的上下文策略实证评估
translated_abstract: 纵向临床推理要求大语言模型（LLM）能够识别并整合分布于漫长患者病史中的相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能够处理越来越多的信息，但提供更多病史并不一定使相关证据更易获取，也不一定能提升推理能力。我们在 MedLoCoMo 数据集上，针对四个开源权重大语言模型比较了五种上下文策略（完整 Full、近期 Recent、情景 Episodic、语义 Semantic 和混合 Hybrid），考察了答案正确性、对查询-证据距离的鲁棒性，以及对前提缺乏依据问题的拒答能力。情景和混合策略总体上取得了最强的准确率，而近期策略随着支持证据距离变远退化最严重；在长距离情形下，情景和混合策略保持了最高的准确率。对对抗性问题的进一步分析表明，在可回答问题上的强劲表现并不一定会转化为……
tldr: 该论文通过在 MedLoCoMo 数据集上系统比较五种上下文策略，发现情景式和混合式上下文策略能显著提升大语言模型在纵向临床推理中的准确率，尤其在证据距离遥远时表现最优，但在可回答问题上的高分并不意味着对前提有误的问题具备可靠的拒答能力。
